description: This line plot illustrates the “Average Correct Gate Rate” across 31 steps (x-axis, ranging from 0 to 31 with integer ticks) for four different input configurations in gated LLMs, as described in the paper “Memorization and Knowledge Injection in Gated LLMs.” The y-axis, labeled “Average Correct Gate Rate,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with major ticks at 0.2 intervals. Four lines are plotted: “Character Attention input” (solid blue), “Character MLP input” (dashed blue), “Wiki Attention input” (solid red), and “Wiki MLP input” (dashed red). Each line is accompanied by a shaded region representing its standard deviation or confidence interval — light blue for Character models and light red for Wiki models. The solid blue line starts near 0.1 at step 0, rises sharply to ~0.8 at step 5, dips to ~0.25 at step 12, then recovers to ~0.75 by step 31. The dashed blue line begins at ~0.82, peaks near 0.92 at step 5, drops to ~0.53 at step 12, and stabilizes around 0.85–0.90 from step 16 onward. The solid red line starts at ~0.2, climbs steeply to ~0.8 at step 5, falls to ~0.37 at step 13, then gradually increases to ~0.7 at step 31. The dashed red line begins at ~0.82, peaks at ~0.88 at step 5, dips to ~0.6 at step 13, and then rises to ~0.85 by step 31. All lines show significant fluctuations, particularly between steps 10 and 15, with the MLP-based inputs (dashed lines) generally maintaining higher gate rates than their Attention counterparts (solid lines) after step 15.
